data.cultural_impact: The name Umyansh is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and culture. Naming a child after a Hindu God showcases a proud and strong connection to this ancient traditions, beliefs, and customs. historical_references.reference: Umyansh was one of the most powerful Gurjar kings, ruling over the Malwa region during the 11th century. He is known for his military prowess and expansive kingdom, which included present-day Madhya Pradesh and parts of Rajasthan.

Another reference states that Umyansh was a Jaina patron and is mentioned in several Jaina texts. He is believed to have supported Jaina monasteries and scholars, and his reign marked a period of religious and cultural flourish for Jainism in the region.
